pretexts: fraudster develops virtual online relationship to gain trust and affection
requests money for travel, medical emergency or family assistance
claims to be successful cryptocurrency investor who can help victim get rich
offers to coach victim on crypto investing
fake approval request appearing to come from crypto service
emerging_tactics: pig butchering (combination of romance and investment fraud)
approval phishing (deceiving victims into granting access to cryptocurrency wallets)
coaching victims on acquiring and investing cryptocurrency
fake transfer requests with links that grant wallet access
allowing small cashouts to encourage larger investments

kill_chain_signals.contact: contacted on dating apps or social media by fraudster attempting to develop relationship
kill_chain_signals.pretext: after trust is gained, fraudster claims to be successful crypto investor and offers to help victim make money
kill_chain_signals.payment: fraudster coaches victim on how to invest in fraudulent cryptocurrency platforms or sends fake approval requests to access wallet
kill_chain_signals.movement: fraudster directs victim to open and fund new crypto accounts and send to wallets they control
kill_chain_signals.cashout: fraudster may let victim cash out some investment returns only to get them to invest larger amount, but victim cannot withdraw when they request

red_flags: someone you haven't met in person professes their love to you
person wants to quickly move to private or different mode of communication
they always have an excuse not to meet in person
individual discourages you from discussing them or their situation with friends and family
someone offering to coach you on crypto investing
key_quote: A fraudster convinces you to enter a virtual, online relationship so the fraudster can gain your trust and affection.
title: Relationship and romance
